name: glass-aquarium
prompt: Build a small glass aquarium: a rectangular transparent tinted glass tank with a visible water volume inside, on a solid base. Use translucent glass and water materials. Keep the scene compact and name the parts clearly.

name: window-wall
prompt: Build a short wall with a blue tinted glass window pane in its opening. The pane must be transparent enough that the background can be seen through it. Name the pane clearly.

name: glass-bottle
prompt: Build a simple transparent blue glass bottle with a hollow-looking body and a narrow neck. Give the bottle glass a translucent material and name the glass part clearly.
